field_meaning.hi: अस्थिर प्रणालियों के लिए नियंत्रण विधि।

review_objections: NVIDIA: Incorrect definition: nonlinear control deals with nonlinear systems, not specifically 'unstable systems'.
Alibaba: Hindi meaning is incorrect; it defines it as a method for 'unstable systems', whereas nonlinear control applies to any system with nonlinear dynamics, stable or unstable.

Google: Hindi meaning describes it as 'control method for unstable systems' (अस्थिर प्रणालियों के लिए नियंत्रण विधि), but nonlinear control applies to both stable and unstable systems; the definition is too narrow/inaccurate.
